description: USE THIS when someone is partway through planning or on a trip and asks what has changed, or "is anything new", at up to three camps since a date (at most 30 days back). It returns only what is new, dated and sourced: National Weather Service alerts issued on or after the date (quoted as written, with the issue time and link), a change in the season window the camp record holds between the date and today, and whether the camp data on davelalande.com was rebuilt after the date. Also lists what was checked and found nothing new, what is not watched (wildfire reports carry no dates, so they are not watched for change), and any read that failed ("could not read; not the same as none"). "Nothing new in what we watch" is not the same as nothing changed. It never says a camp, road or route can be used. Answers include `say` (two sentences to speak) and `tiny` (under 160 characters for a satellite text).

camps.description: One to three camps: record ids from find_camps (best) or camp names.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the date the plan was made or last checked. At most 30 days back, not in the future.
